# Final experiment design (design-only) — MinED vs EM alignment criterion on BBH

**Provenance tags on every substantive claim:** `[ENV-OBS]` = observed in this environment; `[SETUP-FACT]` = supplied by you as a project/setup fact; `[RULING-n]` = your nine adjudications, treated as fixed design constants; `[DESIGN-ASSUME]` = this design's assumption/preset; `[ANALYTIC]` = follows from definitions, provable without data. **No `[RESULT]` tag exists in this document: nothing was run against BBH, no model was called, and no empirical expectation is asserted anywhere.**

---

## 1. 目的 (Purpose)

To determine, under a frozen configuration, whether the MinED alignment criterion **outperforms** the EM criterion on BBH — where "outperforms" is defined **solely against adjudicated correctness**, not against the other criterion `[RULING-5]`.

**Scoping premise `[ANALYTIC]`.** Both criteria are pure functions of one shared generation cache, so this is not a model-quality comparison. Two mechanisms can move the accuracy difference and must never be pooled `[RULING-1]`:
- **M1 — scoring leniency**: MinED accepts near-misses EM rejects (punctuation, truncation, typos).
- **M2 — option alignment**: MinED used to map a free-form generation to the nearest MC option, changing *which* option is scored.

**Structural consequence `[ANALYTIC]`.** Because the normaliser `P` is a function, raw-string equality implies normalised equality, so the accept-sets nest: `EM-raw ⊆ EM-normalised ⊆ MinED(τ)` for every τ ≥ 0 (unit-tested T1–T3, §7). Therefore the accuracy difference **cannot be negative** and is strictly positive whenever any item disagrees. **Condition (i) of the superiority rule is thus analytically near-automatic and carries almost no evidential weight; conditions (iii) and (iv) are the load-bearing ones.** This is a property of the definitions, not a prediction about data, and it is why §4 puts the confirmatory burden on Stage 6.

---

## 2. 設計 (Design — Stages 0–8)

**Stage 0 — Setup ledger and freeze.** Purpose: fix every element and label its provenance before any item is scored. Output: a hashed manifest, **frozen on your written approval**; any post-freeze change forces §3's re-freeze procedure. Frozen contents: (a) **the corrected primary estimand `Δ_task = acc_MinED − acc_EM`** `[RULING-9]`; (b) τ = 0.2, character-level Levenshtein, normalised as `D / max(|P(pred)|, |P(ref)|)` `[RULING-2]`; (c) the shared preprocessing `P` and the shared-cache invariant `[RULING-3]`; (d) model set, k-shot, prompt template, decoding, splits; (e) strata assignment from the format ledger; (f) the four conclusion wordings (§4).

**Stage 1 — Criteria as drop-in scorers over one cache.** Purpose: make the criterion the only difference.
- `P` defined **outside** both criteria, applied identically: whitespace collapse, strip terminal `.` and trailing whitespace, extract span after the `Answer:` trigger, strip bracketed option markers (`"(B) cat" → "cat"`), lower-case.
- `EM: 1[P(pred) == P(ref)]`. `MinED: 1[D(P(pred), P(ref)) / max(|·|,|·|) ≤ 0.2]`.
- **Design invariant (contract clause) `[RULING-3]`: one `P`, one immutable generation cache keyed by `(model, task, item_id, decode_seed)`; both arms are pure functions of that cache; re-generation per arm is prohibited.**

**Stage 2 — Four scoring arms, not two `[RULING-3]`.** To prevent pipeline asymmetry being reported as a criterion difference: **A1 EM-raw**, **A2 EM-normalised**, **A3 MinED(τ=0.2, normalised)**, **A4 BBH-official-extractor arm** — the fourth arm is mandatory whenever the executor cannot confirm whether the source's EM arm internally used the BBH extractor (**U5 remains unknown; the arm is included on that basis, not on a guess**). All four read the same cache. Reporting the nesting chain `A1 ≤ A2 ≤ A3` as a validity check on `P` `[ANALYTIC]`.

**Stage 3 — Dual-branch estimands, never merged `[RULING-1]`.**
- **Estimand-1 (primary, M1)**: per-task `Δ = acc_A3 − acc_A2`, reported on **S3 (4 free-form)** and **S2**; task-unweighted within stratum.
- **Estimand-2 (secondary, M2)**: option-alignment arm — free-form generation mapped to argmin-edit-distance option, then scored by EM against the gold option. Reported in a **separate table with its own CIs**; **no arithmetic combination with Estimand-1, ever.**
- U1 (which role the source intended) stays recorded as **unknown**; the design accommodates both without inferring the source's intent.

**Stage 4 — Fixed-factor harness.** Purpose: confound elimination. Identical across arms: model/checkpoint, tokenizer, template verbatim, exemplar set **and order**, k, `max_new_tokens`, stop strings, extraction code, library/hardware versions, greedy temperature-0 decoding for the primary arm. Immutable artifacts; both criteria computed offline from them.

**Stage 5 — Task strata from the format ledger `[RULING-4]`.** Per-task ledger fields: gold surface form (letter / letter+text / number / date / boolean / word sequence), option text recoverability, mean gold length, trigger present?, extractor used? Strata **S1** (single-token letter MC), **S2** (MC with long or paraphrasable option text), **S3** (free-form) are **generated from the ledger, task by task** — never asserted a priori. **Task identities, including the names of the 4 free-form tasks and each MC task's letter-vs-option-text convention, must be retrieved from the source at execution time; if unavailable, the affected entry is published as `unresolved` and excluded from the confirmatory estimand with the gap disclosed. We do not self-identify task identities.**

**Stage 6 — Validity audit (decisive) `[RULING-5]`.** Purpose: test whether criterion acceptance equals correctness. Stratified random sample of the four cells — A2-only-accept, A3-only-accept, both-accept, both-reject — ~50 items per cell × 3 strata × each model; two independent adjudicators against gold under a fixed rubric; Cohen's κ; arbitration of disagreements. Report each arm's accuracy/κ **relative to adjudicated labels**, plus FP/FN. **Adjudicated correctness is the only reference standard for "better".**

**Stage 7 — Controls** → §3. **Stage 8 — Synthesis** → §4 reporting contract.

---

## 3. 控制 (Controls C1–C7, all retained) with hard stop rule

- **C1 — Negative control (S1).** Criteria provably coincide on single-token letter answers; S1 is excluded from the sign-consistency test and used only as a falsifier.
  - **HARD STOP `[RULING-7]`:** if S1 shows **any** item where the two arms disagree, or a pooled S1 `|Δ| > 0`, the comparison is **void** and **all** criterion-comparison scoring/analysis halts immediately.
  - **Recovery procedure:** (1) freeze and preserve artifacts; (2) triage in this order — divergence in `P`, divergence in extraction/trigger regex, gold-format mismatch, letter-vs-text handling, then scorer implementation (run the T1 τ=0 equivalence unit test against the production scorer); (3) fix; (4) **re-run the τ=0 ≡ EM assertion and the nesting-chain check on the full cache**; (5) publish a defect note.
  - **Re-freeze requirement:** the Stage-0 manifest is invalidated and must be re-issued and **re-approved by you** before any re-scoring. Results computed under the invalidated manifest are never reported.
- **C2 — Normalisation control (2×2).** {raw, `P`-normalised} × {EM, MinED}; decomposes total Δ into `A2−A1` (normalisation) + `A3−A2` (distance leniency). **Both components are non-negative `[ANALYTIC]`, so this is an exact additive decomposition of leniency, not two independent effects.**
- **C3 — Threshold sweep, diagnostic only.** τ ∈ {0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5}. **τ = 0 must reproduce EM exactly** (implementation-equivalence assertion). **Post-hoc τ selection is prohibited `[RULING-2]`;** τ = 0.2 is the pre-set primary.
- **C4 — Length-normalisation control `[RULING-2]`.** Raw `D ≤ k`, k ∈ {1,2,3} — diagnostic only; documents that unnormalised τ is not scale-free across a 1-char letter answer and a 20-word answer.
- **C5 — Prompt-sensitivity control.** ≥2 alternative templates × 2 exemplar orderings on a reduced subset; the *sign* of Δ must be stable, else report a criterion×prompt interaction rather than a main effect.
- **C6 — Distance-family control.** word-level vs character-level ED; case-sensitivity toggle.
- **C7 — Asymmetry ledger.** Itemised verification that no arm receives extraction/normalisation another lacks; operationalised by the Stage-2 four-arm contract.

---

## 4. 分析計畫 (Analysis plan)

**Variance model `[RULING-6]`.** The greedy primary arm is deterministic ⇒ **no seed variance**; the inferential unit is item sampling plus task heterogeneity. Primary inference = **paired, task-stratified bootstrap over items, B = 2000** (same item in both arms always) + **task-level random-effects meta-analysis** (DerSimonian–Laird) over the 23 MC tasks. Sampling arm: 3 decode seeds, paired by item, descriptive.

**Aggregation.** `acc` per task per arm → unweighted mean **within stratum** (S1 | S2 | S3); no pooling of raw item counts; micro-average and 27-task mean are secondary only. Every Δ is published next to its **disagreement rate** and direction split; Δ without that is not reported.

**S3 power `[RULING-6]`.** The 4-task free-form stratum is declared **low-power and descriptive only**; it cannot support a confirmatory claim and no such claim will be made from it. **My recommendation (kept separate from the primary estimand):** supplement the task-level view with **item-level paired tests on the pooled S3 items** — exact **McNemar** on the arm-discordant pairs, plus a **task-clustered** bootstrap (resample tasks, B = 2000) to avoid pretending the 4 tasks are independent draws. These are **supportive/diagnostic**: they increase resolution on within-task asymmetry but cannot substitute for 4 independent task replicates, and a positive item-level signal must be reported as "item-level asymmetry present, task-level evidence insufficient".

**Superiority rule — four conditions, one-sided α = 0.05, all required `[RULING-5]`:** (i) macro Δ > 0; (ii) stratified bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0; (iii) sign consistency on ≥ 2/3 of S2∪S3 tasks with nonzero disagreement; (iv) Stage 6 shows MinED's *extra* acceptances are predominantly **correct**, i.e. MinED also wins on adjudicated correctness.

**Pre-registered conclusion wording (frozen in Stage 0):**
| Conditions met | Permitted wording |
|---|---|
| all four | "Under the frozen configuration, MinED outperforms EM on BBH (S2/S3), judged against adjudicated correctness." |
| (iv) fails, others hold | **"MinED 更寬容，而非更準確" — MinED is more lenient, not more accurate.** No accuracy-quality claim permitted. |
| **only (i)** holds | **Same wording: "MinED is more lenient, not more accurate", plus the mandatory note that condition (i) is analytically near-automatic under the accept-set nesting and is not evidence of superiority.** |
| none hold | "No criterion effect detectable under the frozen configuration; the comparison is inconclusive and S1/implementation checks must be re-examined before any claim." |

**Reporting contract:** all tasks, all four arms, all controls, `unresolved` entries disclosed, no task-level selection after seeing outcomes.

**Recommended refinement R1 (pending your approval, not applied unilaterally):** since Δ ≥ 0 is structurally guaranteed, add **precision of the added acceptances** — the fraction of A3-only-accepted items adjudicated correct — as a secondary confirmatory statistic with a pre-registered bar, so that condition (iv) becomes a quantitative test rather than a qualitative one.

---

## 5. 假設與不確定性 (Assumptions and uncertainties)

**Fixed as `[RULING-n]` design presets, not source facts:** τ = 0.2 with `D/max(|·|,|·|)` normalisation `[RULING-2]`; shared `P` + shared cache invariant and four-arm contract `[RULING-3]`; adjudicated correctness as sole reference `[RULING-5]`; four-condition rule and wordings; B = 2000 stratified paired bootstrap + task random effects `[RULING-6]`; C1 hard stop `[RULING-7]`.

**Open as unknowns, deliberately not resolved `[RULING-1,2,3,4]`:** **U1** MinED used for scoring vs option alignment (dual-branch design, no inference about source intent); **U2** the source's actual τ and normalisation; **U5** whether the source's EM arm embeds the BBH extractor (hence arm A4); **U4** the identity of the 4 free-form tasks and per-MC letter conventions (source-retrieval obligation, else `unresolved`).

**Remaining `[DESIGN-ASSUME]`:** one instruction-tuned open model family at two scales, no closed-API model; BBH-standard 3-shot CoT template with an `Answer:` trigger; lower-cased matching; ~250 items/task official test split; greedy primary + one sampling arm; the macro estimand as the sole confirmatory claim (per-task results descriptive); feasibility of ~50-per-cell adjudication with two adjudicators; execution elsewhere has an offline harness with local checkpoints. **No `[ENV-OBS]` fact from this environment bears on the research question** — it bears only on feasibility (§6).

---

## 6. 可行性契約 (Feasibility contract — a contract, not a verified run)

Requested of the executor; **not** validated here. Derived arithmetic (design parameters, §7):
- **Generations:** 13,500 primary (27 tasks × 250 × 2 models) + 24,000 prompt-sensitivity (12 tasks × 250 × 2 × 4 configs) + 40,500 sampling (× 3 seeds) = **78,000**; ≈ 1,200 prompt + 350 output tokens each.
- **Compute:** **≈ 28–114 GPU-hours** across plausible throughputs (800→200 tok/s/GPU), including a ×3 safety factor for retries and extraction debugging.
- **Storage:** generation cache ≈ **0.23 GB** JSON + <0.1 GB scores/metadata; checkpoints 30–80 GB; **request ≥ 120 GB free**.
- **Human adjudication:** worst case 4 cells × 50 × 3 strata × 2 models = **1,200 items**, two adjudicators ⇒ **≈ 35 person-hours** upper bound (30 + 2 arbitration + 3 calibration); S1 cells may be near-empty, so this is a ceiling.
- **This environment is insufficient to execute `[ENV-OBS]`:** network blocked (DNS/connect failure, `curl` silent), GPU unavailable (`nvidia-smi` driver error), **6.3 GB free of a 1.0 TB mount at 100%**, and no `torch`/`transformers`/`datasets`/`numpy`/`pandas`/`rapidfuzz`/`Levenshtein`; `/workspace` holds only `task.json`, no repository and no BBH copy anywhere on the mount. It **is** sufficient for the permitted design-period verification below — **which is not an experiment and produces no findings about MinED or EM.**

---

## 7. 設計期間之最小技術驗證 (Design-period verification, strictly separated from the experiment)

Stdlib-only unit checks on **synthetic, constructed** string pairs (78 pairs) and synthetic random score vectors. No BBH data, no model, no measurement about the research question:
- **T1** τ = 0 scorer reproduces EM exactly — the C3 implementation-equivalence assertion holds for the specified scorer.
- **T2/T3** accept-set nesting across τ ∈ {0,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.3,0.5,1.0} and monotonicity in τ — confirms `A1 ⊆ A2 ⊆ A3` and the exactness of C2's additive decomposition.
- **T4/T5** unnormalised τ is not scale-free (motivates `D/max(len)`); normalisation is a no-op for EM only when applied to **both** arms (motivates C7).
- **Statistics code paths** all execute in pure stdlib: paired stratified bootstrap B = 2000 over 23 synthetic tasks ≈ 1.2 s single core, task-cluster bootstrap, DerSimonian–Laird meta-analysis, exact McNemar (including the degenerate `b = c = 0 → p = 1` guard).

**These validate that the measurement and inference machinery is implementable and self-consistent. They say nothing about which criterion performs better, and are reported as such.** Nothing else has been executed; the design is complete and awaits your result review.

## 4. 分析計畫 (Analysis plan)

**Variance model `[RULING-6]`.** The greedy primary arm is deterministic ⇒ **no seed variance**; the inferential unit is item sampling plus task heterogeneity. Primary inference = **paired, task-stratified bootstrap over items, B = 2000** (same item in both arms always) + **task-level random-effects meta-analysis** (DerSimonian–Laird) over the 23 MC tasks. Sampling arm: 3 decode seeds, paired by item, descriptive.

**Aggregation.** `acc` per task per arm → unweighted mean **within stratum** (S1 | S2 | S3); no pooling of raw item counts; micro-average and 27-task mean are secondary only. Every Δ is published next to its **disagreement rate** and direction split; Δ without that is not reported.

**S3 power `[RULING-6]`.** The 4-task free-form stratum is declared **low-power and descriptive only**; it cannot support a confirmatory claim and no such claim will be made from it. **My recommendation (kept separate from the primary estimand):** supplement the task-level view with **item-level paired tests on the pooled S3 items** — exact **McNemar** on the arm-discordant pairs, plus a **task-clustered** bootstrap (resample tasks, B = 2000) to avoid pretending the 4 tasks are independent draws.
